Messages.Author: Malcolm McCallum
Messages.Body:
Did I miss an errata that made it illegal to move Loc-equipments with
Heidelburg Castle? I've just seen the possibility of tossing around a
fully charged Invernary Castle *after* the bleed action has gotten
through blockers. Please tell me that this is illegal.
It is definitely immoral. :)

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <Pine.BSI.3.91.96060...@tubby.pacificcoast.net>,


Since Locquipment aren't equipment once in play, they cannot
be moved around by HC,because HC only moves equipment and blood,
not locations.

Messages.Author: The Corrupter
Messages.Body:
On Tue, 4 Jun 1996, Malcolm McCallum wrote:

> Did I miss an errata that made it illegal to move Loc-equipments with
> Heidelburg Castle? I've just seen the possibility of tossing around a
> fully charged Invernary Castle *after* the bleed action has gotten
> through blockers. Please tell me that this is illegal.
> It is definitely immoral. :)

It is definitely illegal.

Locquipment only counts as equipment when it is in your hand or in the
deck. Once it is in play, it is no longer treated as equipment, but only
as a location.
